scope: Kill retarget, player-city hero summon, rebirth abandonment retry, passive point buttons on the native ability bar, retired passive management window

implementation.tower: Select and order the next legal target immediately on target death, without Stop/disarm between enemies. Recover an interrupted order on the next 0.25-second think. Preserve tree exclusion and explicit idle when no enemy exists.
implementation.summon: Resolve the live completed main city belonging to the requesting player; search nearby grounded, navigable, unoccupied positions with hero clearance. Fail before charging if no safe position exists.
implementation.rebirth: Successful F2 return or challenger death cancels the owned rebirth attempt without completion rewards. Retry after 2 seconds. Actual progression, rather than attempt count, locks completed tiers.
implementation.passive_points: Gold plus above an eligible passive in the existing native ability bar. Server validates actor, hero entity, observed level, ownership, lock, max level and available points before spending. Duplicate observed-level requests cannot spend twice.
implementation.removed_ui: Upper-left passive button, management window, its tooltip/list rendering, and its state request/push logic removed. Actual skills and reward choice UI retained.

regression_pass.ui_compilation: 8 source entry points compiled, 0 failures; game authoring copies and content sources match 8/8

live.environment: Local survival Workshop template_map, authenticated test backend, pure mode, N1; single local player

rebirth.flow: Real shop purchase -> F2 return ability -> early retry rejected -> 2-second cooldown -> second real purchase -> F2 return ability

passive_plus.method: Physical clicks in the verified 1600x900 Dota test window

limits: Multiplayer ownership/isolation cases are covered by regression tests; no multi-client live session was run.
The tower live probe uses real engine attacks and KV/modifier behavior in an isolated area; it does not establish timing for every tower class or network latency.
Test-only setup paused wave spawning and cancelled the unbuilt-wall defeat timer; neither production rule was changed. Fixture builder and buildings received temporary protection.

Test-only builder positioning was assisted after validating work points, so construction pathfinding is not claimed as validated. Hero summoning and both challenge purchases used the normal business interfaces.
Test evidence folder name contains 20260924; actual run date is 2026-09-23.
